verdicts.reason: A breaks the benefit list into scattered pieces: 'Garden herbs' sits alone at the far left and 'Wild honey' at the far right, so the items are out of order. The squashed Solstice logo pill is jammed against the CTA and its wordmark can't be read. B has clearer left-to-right flow, with the CTA set apart at the right end and the logo kept intact. But its headline is undersized, the bullet sizes don't match ('Pressed blood orange' is tiny), and the 'Wild honey' bullet is stranded above the logo at an unreadable size.

A reads in order: logo, then headline, bullets, CTA and can. Its CTA is clear, but the bullet sizes don't match ('Pressed blood orange' is tiny), the 'Wild honey' bullet floats tiny above the CTA, and the headline is small. B has the same flaws as the earlier fragmented layout: bullets spread across the whole width out of sequence, and a crushed logo pill butting into the CTA with an illegible wordmark.
